name: katalog-tts
description: Read the active file aloud with offline Piper neural TTS, highlighting the current sentence and word, with play/pause/stop/speed controls and selectable voices.

katalogTts.pythonPath.description: Path to the Python interpreter (relative to the workspace folder, or absolute).

katalogTts.serverScript.description: Path to tts_server.py (relative to the workspace folder, or absolute).

katalogTts.voicesDir.description: Folder scanned for .onnx voices (relative to the workspace folder, or absolute).

katalogTts.model.description: Default Piper .onnx voice model (used until a voice is picked via 'Katalog: Select voice').

katalogTts.config.description: Default Piper .onnx.json config matching the default model.

katalogTts.rate.description: Base speech rate. 1.0 = natural; >1.0 = faster. The 2x button doubles this.

katalogTts.wordHighlightColor.description: Background color of the word currently being spoken.

katalogTts.sentenceHighlightColor.description: Background color of the sentence currently being spoken.
